ApprovalDigest.description: BLAKE3 over a stored approval document's bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

ManifestDigest.description: BLAKE3 over an immutable package manifest's bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

SchemaVersion.description: A document layout version, written as <major>.<minor> in decimal with no leading zeros. Each component is additionally bounded below 65536, which the pattern cannot express and the parser enforces.

description:
The record that declares one reviewed generation released as a preview.

**This is the third document, and the reference still runs one way.** It
names the manifest and the approval; neither names it, and neither has a
field that could. `DELIVERY-PLAN.md`'s M2 acceptance requires the approval
recorded "without a checksum cycle", and a cycle here is not merely absent
but unrepresentable —
`t3_e2_release_record_references_manifest_and_approval_without_cycle`
asserts that on the field lists rather than by scanning bytes.

approval_blake3.description: BLAKE3 of the approval document that reviewed that manifest.
